subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reactions first be exposed as passive plugin events, retained/queryable records, or both under one privacy, retention, and routing contract?
rationale: The issue combines two materially different capabilities: receiving reaction events and retaining searchable historical data. Repository policy makes persistent-state changes and agent-routing changes intentional product choices.

options.title: Passive events first
options.body: Expose add/remove reaction events through the WhatsApp plugin without starting agent turns or promising historical retention.

options.title: Persist and query reactions
options.body: Approve an explicit retention, identity, access-control, and SQLite migration design before adding a generic reaction-read action.

options.title: Combined contract
options.body: Design and ship passive events plus historical querying together as one cross-channel reaction data model.

recommendation.title: Passive events first
recommendation.body: Expose add/remove reaction events through the WhatsApp plugin without starting agent turns or promising historical retention.

likelyOwner.reason: Current WhatsApp action and inbound-path history makes this the best available routing candidate.
